Class RawEventCardData

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.factories.RawEventCardData
public class RawEventCardData extends Object
A lightweight Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to map flat JSON records of event cards.

This class serves as an intermediate data structure during the game initialization phase. It holds template values for both mid-game events and game-ending final events. Depending on the effectType, specific subsets of fields will be populated, leaving the rest as null.

The CardFactory consumes instances of this class to instantiate the corresponding concrete domain-model event entities with their respective scoring or penalty parameters.
